content.text: Visit Queen's Explore our university See our campus for yourself. Explore our historic buildings, contemporary centres of art and culture, classrooms, residences, and much more. Visit Kingston Parking Paid underground parking Paid underground parking for visitors to the main campus of Queen's University is available in the parking garage located at the corner of University Avenue and Stuart Street (enter from Stuart Street) as well as the Queen’s Centre parking garage (enter from Division Street). View on map Permit parking Parking permits are required for all Queen's surface lots and Queen's designated on-street permit parking spots from 7 am – 4 pm Monday through Friday inclusive (but not statutory holidays). The lot behind McLaughlin Hall requires a permit 24 hours per day all year. Queen's parking Free parking Limited free parking is also available along some city streets (with time restrictions). Use of permit parking spaces is also allowed after designated hours (some restrictions apply).
